method: Actual view_image inspection of seven assembly, four frame-only and two isolated propulsion renders, compared against catalog, dimensional and physical photo references.

numerical_validation.note: Numerical checks do not certify visual accuracy or real manufacturing tolerances.

findings.observation: Canopy reads as thin ladder rails with rectangular crossbars and simple exposed lens collar; visible formed hood, shoulders and rounded arch apertures are too slight/rectilinear.
findings.action: Broaden and blend estimated curved cap around upper collar, retain small vent, shape rounded trapezoidal/oval arch openings and smooth transitions to lateral legs. Preserve open sides, camera PCB visibility, mounting anchors, 10.2 mm clamp and camera pose.
findings.uncertainty: Unmeasured local cap depth, thickness and window contours remain visual estimates. Current hood object exists; finding concerns its rendered shape.
findings.acceptance: Formed hood and curved aperture shapes read in front and oblique views without closing real side spaces or changing locked dimensions.

findings.observation: Outer blade taper is more leaf-like than the broad rounded paddle ends in the GF1207 reference.
findings.action: Apply PR-01 estimated chord/sweep/terminal refinement. Main may evaluate PR-02 hub radius 2.4 mm trial within existing estimate range. Preserve 31 mm envelope, 6.8 mm maximum chord, 3.3 mm hub height and 1 mm bore.
findings.shared_dimension_change_recommended: Only centrally approved estimated hub-radius trial; no verified dimension change.
findings.uncertainty: Exact airfoil/camber/twist and pixel contour are unverified.
findings.acceptance: Broad round-cornered terminal reads in matched top/oblique views; maximum evaluated radius remains nominal.

findings.observation: Dark crescents/slivers surround motor-pad bores; dark bridge lines and some abrupt rib/rim joins differ from smooth continuous reference moulding.
findings.action: Inspect evaluated topology, coincident faces, non-planar triangulation, normals, touching Boolean boundaries and modifiers; fix confirmed defects. Preserve a continuous rounded triangular pad and intended screw protectors. Use diagnostic material to distinguish shadows from topology faults.
findings.uncertainty: Exact cause has not been diagnosed by this reviewer; lighting may contribute to some edges.
findings.acceptance: No unintended sliver seams under neutral inspection lighting; hole sizes, pad continuity and frame dimensions preserved.

findings.observation: Reference plan shows narrow fore/aft transverse openings beside the large central cradle opening; model shows only the large opening between two simple bands.
findings.action: Recover narrow windows by refining estimated offset/sloped upper/lower band form, checking reference construction rather than adding arbitrary bars. Preserve 11.4 x 6.2 mm opening and optional battery clearance.
findings.uncertainty: Plan-view openings may result from projected offset upper/lower cradle bands; detailed 3D construction is not fully established.
findings.acceptance: Corresponding plan apertures visible without blocking the verified battery opening.

findings.observation: Visible PCB is olive green instead of black masked; lens reads as flat green disk with concentric rings rather than darker recessed optical stack.
findings.action: Verify already-reported mask surface correction in next render. Then improve estimated lens recess/glass shading without changing 10 mm barrel diameter or 15 mm front-to-board depth.
findings.uncertainty: Optical tint depends on viewpoint and illumination; exact internal lens construction is not established.
findings.acceptance: PCB has visible black mask with thin substrate edge and optical face has a plausible recessed dark/glass appearance.

findings.observation: Frame/canopy are uniformly pastel and relatively opaque; props cloudy; PCB solder-pad/trace density and underside electronics are simplified.
findings.action: Tune transmission, roughness and lighting after geometry. Refine only supported electronic surface details. Keep a diagnostic view and avoid unverifiable labels.
findings.uncertainty: Catalog lighting/retouching may exaggerate transmission; small component placement is estimated.
findings.acceptance: Geometry remains legible while polymer transmission and board surface density better match both physical and catalog references.

supported_observations.assessment: Four circular ducts, square motor pattern, rotated central mounting pattern, four arms per duct and open baskets agree qualitatively with the II frame references.
supported_observations.recommendation: No global frame dimension or motor-center change supported.

supported_observations.assessment: Overall exposed camera, open canopy and rearward/upward antenna arrangement appropriate.
supported_observations.recommendation: No global height change from unmatched perspective views; installed positions remain estimates.

supported_observations.assessment: Layered motor can/open crown plausible; integrated three-wire bundles now present.
supported_observations.recommendation: Exact internal motor topology and wire bends remain estimates; motor-side heatshrink secondary refinement.

supported_observations.assessment: Absent optional battery is consistent with baseline scope.
supported_observations.recommendation: Do not call absence a defect against battery-equipped underside reference.

limitations: No physical metrology or manufacturer CAD
No calibrated view alignment or silhouette-overlap score
Catalog images may be rendered or retouched
Physical photos have perspective, blur and specimen differences
No numerical dimensional certification from photographs
next_review: Inspect preserved matching views after canopy/prop corrections, frame sliver diagnosis, and documented dispositions of remaining findings.
